originating_goal: Ensure a verified native sovereign runtime can consume all already-requested bounded resident tasks without waiting for a later filesystem change and without one fail-closed request starving independent requests.
release_condition: Release after exact-head validation and merge. Native bootstrap execution and resident request consumption remain separate machine evidence gates.
collision_boundaries: Do not mint, replace, or widen any task claim or fence.
Do not make HeartBeat progression depend on request dispatch.
Do not treat hosted validation as resident execution.
Do not acquire or forward GitHub/provider credentials.
Do not infer any app activation from dispatcher invocation.
Each request-specific consumer retains its existing admission and exactly-once semantics.
